prompt: Write a search-result summary of the memory content below that keeps the decisive fact, in at most 220 characters. Return only the summary text without preamble or quotes.

summaries.summary: The shared Kotlin networking layer uses Ktor HttpClient with the Darwin engine on iOS and the OkHttp engine on Android.
The retired Android-only client used Retrofit with Gson and had no iOS implementation.
Firestore vector indexes and GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS must both use 768 dimensions with cosine distance.
The MetaCortex database must be configured to use Firestore Native mode instead of Datastore mode.
Each custom MCP client profile has its own unique bearer token, tool allowlist, branch-state allowlist, and browser origin allowlist.
MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS applies only to the default admin endpoint and defaults to denying browser origins.
Write fingerprints suppress duplicate memory writes for 15 minutes, while the fingerprint document is retained for 30 days.
Consolidation merges multiple source memories into one active record, deprecating the sources by setting their "superseded_by" field to the merged ID.
October deployment notes: Cloud Functions are deployed to us-central1 because the Firestore database lives in nam5 and cross-region calls added latency. Routine housekeeping was also performed.
Recovery runbook revision three: Full Firestore backups run nightly at 03:00 UTC, and portable archives are pushed weekly on Sundays.
Restore tooling notes: Always run a dry run first because write-mode restore can prune documents that are absent from the archive.
Deprecated memories receive an expires_at timestamp and are deleted by the Firestore TTL policy after ninety days.
Authentication migration log: Legacy URL-embedded credentials remain accepted during transition, but new clients must send bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
Model selection notes: gemini-embedding-001 was chosen over text-embedding-004 as the embedding model due to its superior multilingual quality.
Merge pipeline notes: The LLM merge step uses a flash-tier Gemini model with temperature zero to ensure consolidations are reproducible.
Search response design: search_context returns only a 220-character summary per hit, and clients must call fetch_context to retrieve the full content.
The Android app UI is built using Jetpack Compose and Material 3 theming.
The iOS shell is built with SwiftUI and embeds the shared Kotlin module as an XCFramework.
CI runs verification gates on Node 22 to match the Functions engine.
Each client is rate limited to 60 search requests per minute.
An early prototype stored memories in Datastore mode before migrating to vector search.
Monthly Gemini spend is capped at $20 by a budget alert.
Portable archives are newline-delimited JSON files grouped by topic.
Every fetch_context call writes a retrieval event used for implicit relevance labels.
